theory.intro: To **evaluate** a power, write it in expanded form and multiply the factors together.
facts: An index of $1$ leaves the number unchanged: $412^{1}=412$.
For any positive whole-number index, a power of $1$ is $1$, and a power of $0$ is $0$.
For a positive whole-number index, a power of $10$ is a $1$ followed by that many zeros, so $10^{4}=10\,000$.
$10^{6}$ is one million and $10^{9}$ is one billion.
steps: Write the power in expanded form.
Multiply the factors together, working from left to right.

workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) The index $3$ means three factors of $6$.
$6^{3}=6\times6\times6$
$=36\times6$
$=216$
(b) Multiply the three equal factors.
$7\times7\times7=49\times7$
$=343$

(a) An index of $1$ means one factor.
$73^{1}=73$
(b) Multiplying twenty-four factors of $1$ still gives $1$.
$1^{24}=1$
(c) Multiplying six factors of $0$ gives $0$.
$0^{6}=0$

workedExamples.question_text:
(a) Evaluate $10^{6}$ as a basic numeral.
(b) Write $100\,000\,000$ as a power of $10$.
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) $10^{6}$ means six factors of $10$.
$10^{6}=10\times10\times10\times10\times10\times10$
$=1\,000\,000$
(b) $100\,000\,000$ is a $1$ followed by eight zeros.
$100\,000\,000=10^{8}$

workedExamples.question_text:
(a) Write $5040$ in expanded form using powers of $10$.
(b) Write $2\times10^{4}+6\times10^{2}+9$ as a basic numeral.
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) Split the number by place value. The hundreds and ones digits are zero.
$5040=5000+40$
$=5\times10^{3}+4\times10^{1}$
(b) Evaluate each power, then add the place-value amounts.
$2\times10^{4}+6\times10^{2}+9$
$=20\,000+600+9$
$=20\,609$

workedExamples.question_text:
(a) Which is larger, $2^{7}$ or $7^{2}$?
(b) A colony starts with $1$ cell and doubles every hour. After how many whole hours does it first contain more than $40$ cells?
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) Evaluate both powers before comparing.
$2^{7}=2\times2\times2\times2\times2\times2\times2=128$
$7^{2}=7\times7=49$
Since $128>49$, $2^{7}$ is larger.
(b) The numbers of cells after $1$, $2$, $3$, $4$, $5$ and $6$ hours are $2$, $4$, $8$, $16$, $32$ and $64$.
After $5$ hours, $2^{5}=32$ is not more than $40$.
After $6$ hours, $2^{6}=64$ is more than $40$.
The colony first passes $40$ cells after $6$ hours.

development.question_text: Write one billion (a $1$ followed by $9$ zeros) as a power of $10$.
Write $537$ in expanded form using powers of $10$.

The number of people infected by a disease doubles every day.
On day $0$ one person is infected.
How many are infected on day $6$?

mastery.question_text: Write $8\,000\,500$ in expanded form using powers of $10$.

A colony of cells doubles every hour.
It starts with $1$ cell.
After how many whole hours does the colony first contain more than $1000$ cells?
mastery.solution_text:
$2^{9}$
$=512$, which is not more than $1000$
$2^{10}$
$=1024$
The colony first passes $1000$ cells after $10$ hours.
